limits: Source parity verifies retention of production files/manifest declarations, not all feature behaviour.
Emulator durability tests include repeated classes; test execution counts are not unique feature counts.
AOSP owner-release test uses debug harness and ADB for final uninstall; release APK excludes harness.
Local teardown verifies owner/admin absence before purge and requests Android uninstall; Android may require user confirmation.
Manual purge test is on unmanaged AOSP; combined managed local runner and OEM removal still require physical-device verification.
Beta evidence excludes raw coordinates/radio identifiers/credentials; normal authenticated history is separate.
User exports and backend history are not erased by local app purge; a non-sensitive teardown guard remains until uninstall.
